headwords: ăn cơm quốc gia, thờ ma cộng sản
ăn quả nhớ kẻ trồng cây

flags.why: The word describes eating supplementary foods alongside milk, rather than specifically starting to eat them ([Vinmec](https://www.vinmec.com/vie/bai-viet/tap-cho-be-dam-nhu-nao-vi)).
flags.fix: (of a baby) to eat supplementary foods in addition to milk

flags.why: The sexual sense is the usual contemporary meaning and should precede the cohabitation sense ([Vietnamese dictionary](https://vi.wiktionary.org/wiki/ăn_nằm)).
flags.fix: Put sense 2 first, followed by senses 1 and 3.
